title: Our Marriage — Where Do We Stand?
description: A satisfaction check-in across 14 areas of married life. Rate each item honestly, based on where things stand right now, not how you wish they were. This is a general questionnaire, so give the most generic answer that fits most days — not just how things have been in an unusually good or bad stretch.

scoring.method: average the 1-5 scores within each category; also compute an overall average across all 100 items. Categories averaging below 3 are 'areas to focus on'; 3-4 are 'solid ground'; above 4 are 'a real strength'.
